title: LSDE v2 is avaible
author: djmisterjon
selftext:
Hi am devs this since 3yr  
The tool is primarily designed for studio and solo developers, but I’ve also added tools for vibedevs.  
  
And for its 2 years public release, **LSDE has moved to V2 with lots of new features for gamedevs and appdevs** and to sell your product worldwide.  
  
A page redesign and updated documentation, along with many UI/UX refactorings that were reported during V1  
LSDE is officially no longer in beta but **stable in PROD and validated by a handful of studios and polyglots specializing in localization and translation** (thanks to all beta testers).  
  
What's news?  
\- CPU/GPU bytecode overhaul of the UX/UI to make the experience cleaner, more intuitive, and \~\*10 times more performant than v1.  
\- support for new technologies, MCP/LLM, but with the ability to disable everything AI-related for studios that wish to focus on their human resources.  
\- CLI to control LSDE scenes with your software like Unity, Godot, UE ...  
\- new voice system, emotion enhancement, and lip sync  
\- free scene generator for character narrative consistency, correcting them, inspiring you, and suggesting ideas.  
\- Backward compatibility for V1 projects: *you don't have to do anything.*  
  
**- >> Trial versions have been reset <<**
